lesson: A positivity statement at P = t^theta reads only the band-limited part (frequencies <= theta log t) of the zero measure. Its zero-side reach grows linearly with the local number of off-line pairs and is not a zero-free region; one-pair heuristics overstate what such devices exclude. Passing rows are fine-tuned to about 100 P^(-b) in the ordinates. No step uses multiplicativity; ZQ passes in the window with 3 or more quadruples.
